newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine says Nomura to manage September Japan bond.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine says Nomura to manage September Japan bond.

text.p: Japan's Nomura International will be lead manager when Ukraine launches its first foreign bonds in Japan in September, Deputy Prime Minister Serhiy Tyhypko, in charge of reforms, told a news conference on Thursday.
"The lead manager will be Nomura," he said. "Nomura's lawyers are settling legal questions and we should receive our first money in September." He did not say how much Ukraine planned to issue.
